recentItems.title: Exploring Scotland’s Coastal Town | Scotland’s Golden Coast
recentItems.description:
A joyous journey along Scotland’s sublime and wildly beautiful east coast, meeting the people who work and play here, and those lucky enough to call it home. 

From an unusual cricket club on the golden sands of Elie in Fife and Stonehaven’s much-loved Art Deco outdoor pool to Siccar Point’s resplendent rocks, a spectacular tourist season awaits. (Scotland’s Golden Coast Series 1 Episode 2)

First Shown: 30th September 2026

recentItems.title: Uncovering Ireland’s Haunted History | Martin & Roman's Irish Road Trip
recentItems.description:
Martin and Roman Kemp set off on a road trip around Ireland. There's bants and bonding galore as father and son go in search of landscape, history, mystery and legends.

In wintry, freezing Northern Ireland, Martin and Roman seek out selkies and vampires, spend a fretful night at a haunted hotel, and sample Derry’s spectacular Halloween Festival. (Martin & Roman's Irish Road Trip Series 1, Episode 3)

recentItems.title: Discovering Scotland's Hidden Wonders Along Its Spectacular Coastline | Scotland’s Golden Coast
recentItems.description:
A joyous journey along Scotland’s sublime and wildly beautiful east coast, from the Moray Firth to the Borders, as we meet the people who work and play here, and those lucky enough to call it home. 

Our journey begins with a campervan adventure to discover some of the coast's remarkable lighthouses, from the Firth of Forth to the enchanting Tentsmuir Forest and the extraordinary Rattray Head. (Scotland’s Golden Coast Series 1 Episode 1)
